svg.title: Thin-wall soil sampler — Þunnveggja jarðsýnishólkur
svg.desc: A long smooth open sampling tube has a thin upper rim and a plain lower cutting lip.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-thin-wall-soil-sampler","label_en":"Thin-wall soil sampler","label_is":"Þunnveggja jarðsýnishólkur","section":"03","category_en":"Site setup, surveying and ground investigation","category_is":"Aðstaða, landmælingar og jarðkönnun","batch":2,"tags":["ground-investigation","sampling"],"description":"A long smooth open sampling tube has a thin upper rim and a plain lower cutting lip.","design_note":"The unsegmented hollow tube has no teeth, split barrel or motor; its simple form is the actual sampler.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
